operations.description: Page through the audit log in sequence order. Filter by event kinds (for example egress.denied or command.denied) and outcome; pass the returned nextAfterSeq to continue. Inputs appear only as digests unless a capability allow-lists a field.

Recompute the audit log hash chain up to the current head and report any edited, removed, reordered or truncated events. A clean result proves internal consistency; compare the head with an off-host copy to rule out a full rewrite.

Read the current security posture: hardening profile, network mode, every declared destination with whether it is bound, disabled or isolated and how often it was used or denied, policy findings, audit-chain integrity and audit forwarding health. Use it to answer what this installation can reach and whether its audit trail is intact.
List qualitative code groups and defect codes published by the quality system, with their valuation.
Set the usage decision for a fully inspected open lot as supervisor. Supply lot:<id> in expectedRevisions so results recorded after you reviewed the lot cause a conflict instead of being ignored.
Record a defect with a catalog code and quantity for an open lot as inspector or supervisor.
Integration principal only: record the quality system outcome for a forwarded result, defect or decision.

Read one inspection lot with its characteristics, specification limits, active results, defects, usage decision and the next open sample. Use its revision as lot:<id> in a decision expectedRevisions map.
List inspection lots at plants where you hold a role, with capture progress and synchronization counts. Authorization precedes filtering, counting and pagination.
Integration principal only: apply a batch of lots and code groups from the quality system and advance the watermark. A stale from watermark conflicts.

Summarize capture economics for your plants: datapoints captured by humans and by agents with median and 90th-percentile milliseconds from ready to commit, corrections, out-of-tolerance results, and how long the quality system took to accept forwarded records.
List plants where you hold a role. Supervisors also see the plant membership.
Grant or remove a plant role as supervisor of that plant. A null role removes access. You cannot change your own role. Permission changes invalidate affected views.

Supersede a result with a corrected value or code and a reason. Supervisors may correct any result at their plant; inspectors only their own. The original is retained for audit. Use this to resolve a quality-system rejection.

Record one measured value (quantitative) or code (qualitative) for a characteristic sample of an open lot as inspector or supervisor. occurredAt is when the measurement happened (epoch ms, at most 24 h old). Omit sample to use the next open one. The receipt proves the local commit; the quality system accepts or rejects it later.
Record up to 100 measurements for one open lot in a single commit, for example from an instrument export. All succeed or none do. Each result is forwarded to the quality system separately.

ui.exception: instrument import by agents and scripts; people record one sample at a time

operations.description: Summarize synchronization with the quality system for your plants: pending, accepted and rejected records, the oldest pending item, recent rejections and the last master-data sync.
Return the next characteristic and sample to measure for an open lot, and how many samples remain. Call it after each recorded result to drive capture.

ui.exception: agent capture loop; the capture screen reads the next sample from lot.get

network.purpose: Forward audit events off the host (RFC 5424 syslog over TLS).
Serve the frontend, API, events and attach connections.
Model catalog and inference for Codex and AI SDK runs.
ChatGPT sign-in: token exchange, OIDC discovery, signing keys and revocation.
Forward results, defects and usage decisions to the quality system and pull lots and characteristics from it.

processes.purpose: Claude Code process driven by the Agent SDK.
Codex app-server harness under a delegated grant.

workflows.text: Find the open lot, read its characteristics and limits, then record each measurement for the sample named by the worklist. For an instrument export, map rows to characteristics and samples and submit them with record-batch in one commit; never invent values that are not in the source. Use the measurement time from the source as occurredAt. Report out-of-tolerance results and record a defect only when the source states one. Leave the usage decision to a supervisor.

Start with the posture. For any check that is not passing, list the matching audit events (for example kinds egress.denied, command.denied or posture.checked) and verify the chain before drawing conclusions. Report destinations by ID and state; never infer that an unbound destination was reached.

Read rejected records from sync status, inspect the lot and the rejection reason, and explain each one. Correct a result only when the reason identifies a clear entry error and the correct value is known; supply that reason. Otherwise ask the user. A correction is forwarded again and may itself be rejected.
